title: R2 · needle tip
changes: Distal blade redrawn: nearly straight inner edge, outer edge raised, long taper into a needle point. Point is 0.6 mm wide x 1.6 mm thick 1 mm back, 1.1 x 2.1 at 2 mm (R1: 2.2 x 1.8 and 3.7 x 2.3; Gen 7: 5.4 x 5.0 and 7.9 x 5.3). The tip is no longer rounded by the 0.8 mm smoothing offset.
Blade width at the dot cut from about 1.8x to about 1.3x the shank, and about 1x a little further out.
Ridges: 11 V teeth in a continuous row along the drawn inner edge (0.9 mm deep, 1.3 mm mouth, through the full thickness), kept beside the 6 through-slots.

Head honeycomb tighter: holes as large as the walls allow (up to 17 px, i.e. 3.4 mm). Shank holes follow one regular taper, 13.5 px down to 8 px, instead of alternating big and small. The black dot stays the single larger hole.
Inner-edge shoulders mid-shank smoothed into a swell and a ramped step; blade-root step on the outer edge made a longer S-curve. This removes the steep dark wall seen in top.png.
Base hook redrawn as a rounded J-claw with a round bowl and a fat rounded toe.
Wall bands: finer outline (167 points, $fn 48) and a 160-step wedge instead of 40.
verdict: accepted blade-width rejection; next round r3
review: Outer blade edge nearly straight; photos show a gentle convex belly to about 60% of the blade.
Tip still 1.6 mm thick at 1 mm back.
Ridges too coarse, read as a saw.
Mid-shank holes smaller and further apart than the photo's near-continuous chain.
Mid-shank step slightly too ramped and too far toward the tip.
Closed tips pinch with a visible gap near the points.

accepted: Tip too fat/short taper; needle point under 1 mm.
Denser head honeycomb; regular hole taper.
Blocky shoulders and the dark wall near y=550 in top.png.
Base hook should be a rounded J-claw.
Faceting bands on the extrusion walls.
partly_rejected: Claim 1's blade at 1/3 to 1/2 of the shank width: the top, robot and target photos show a dagger about as wide as the shank, but the two_hands photo (the trace source) shows the blade about 1.7x the shank, and the black dot needs a wall around it. So the blade is about 1.3x the shank at the dot and about 1x further out. The point, the long taper and the under-1 mm tip were taken as asked.
